headerDisplay: Philips Air+ cloud fans (CX3550/01 and similar). Close the Philips Air+ phone app while Homebridge is running: the cloud allows one connection per account.

refreshSeconds.title: State refresh interval (seconds)
refreshSeconds.description: How often to re-read the fan's state, so changes made with its own buttons show up in HomeKit. Changes made in HomeKit are confirmed within a few seconds either way.

ignore.title: Device IDs to hide from HomeKit
